name: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Insurance Premium for Shrimp Crop Insurance
benefit: - 50% subsidy on the insurance premium paid for shrimp crop insurance.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be a farmer and involved in shrimp farming. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID). 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.
